changelog.summary: Turn a reproducible service or page regression into an owner-reviewed change plan tied to the exact build and performance budget.

title: Performance Regression to Owned Change
description: Turn a reproducible service or page regression into an owner-reviewed change plan tied to the exact build and performance budget.
setup_prompt: Use Performance Regression to Owned Change as a chat-led proposal. Inspect existing Crews, source permissions, exact subject, owner and action policy. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, typed handoffs, a real manual first case and separate approval for consequential actions. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection enables no write or recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: One service or page, endpoint or journey, baseline and regressed builds, environment, traffic condition and Engineering owner.
Use comparable trace or test runs, performance budget revision, deployment timeline, issue/PR/CI state and change policy.
A metric change needs comparable conditions and coverage; correlation with a deploy is a hypothesis. An accepted change plan is not a deployed fix.
Accountable source, decision and action owners
Authorized connections or equivalent current exports
Manual-only or reviewed event and schedule policy
